findings.summary: Later classification proposal referenced unfrozen prompts while Run 2 prompts embed the obsolete corpus.
findings.resolution: Proposal now requires a separate no-execution preregistration that freezes new prompts and uses byte-identical prompts across both later arms.

findings.summary: Three positive and thirteen negative pairs cannot express the prior percentage tolerances.
findings.resolution: Gold adequacy and discrete resolution are explicit; later protocol must preregister attainable exact-count criteria and uncertainty and may not inherit Run 2 thresholds.

findings.summary: Gold rationales and audit trail were insufficient for independent verification.
findings.resolution: Every pair now has a pair-specific rationale and the draft-to-candidate substitution is recorded.
